sanskrit_verse:
प्रच्छन्नदोषव्यामिश्रं पुनः संस्कृतविक्रयी ।
पण्ये तद् द्विगुणं दाप्यो वणिग्दण्डं च तत्समम् ॥
transliteration: pracchannadoṣavyāmiśraṃ punaḥ saṃskṛtavikrayī / paṇye tad dviguṇaṃ dāpyo vaṇigdaṇḍaṃ ca tatsamam //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who knowingly sells goods mixed with concealed defects after refurbishment shall compensate double the value of the item and face equal merchant-discipline as prescribed for fraud.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The seller holds duty-bound capacity to ensure integrity in trade.
Causation: Concealment of defect post-refurbishment directly causes misinformed transaction.
Capacity-based responsibility: Seller's knowledge determines level of accountability.
Restoration logic: Compensation restores balance between parties through conscious correction.
Consciousness alignment: Truthful disclosure aligns commerce with dharmic transparency.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a seller knowingly conceals defects in refurbished goods THEN compensation = 2 × item_value
IF fraud detected THEN apply vaṇigdaṇḍa equivalent to offense magnitude
IF transaction involves willful deception THEN initiate restorative reintegration protocol
IF seller lacks intent THEN reduce liability via proportional error-correction mechanism
supreme_court_application: In commercial disputes involving concealed defects, the Supreme Court shall assess seller intent, verify presence of deliberate concealment, and enforce double restitution alongside disciplinary measures aligned with vaṇigdaṇḍa principles without punitive framing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between defective sale and harm; anupūrvaśaḥ traces fault back to seller’s conscious act; proportional responsibility ensures correction matches awareness-level; no punitive inference arises—only completion of transactional integrity through conscious reparation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate 'Vyavahara Shuddhi' process to restore buyer confidence and financial equity
Engage 'Dharmic Commerce Realign' module to reintegrate seller into ethical trading framework
Deploy 'Vani Sambandha Sudharan' system to educate on truthful disclosure obligations
Activate 'Samatva Pratiphalana' mechanism ensuring both parties reach transactional equilibrium
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored when commerce reflects truth-consciousness; justice operates solely for realignment, never for punishment; reality itself adjudicates through awakened discernment.
